card.name: Small words after a count of cycles or patients
card.fires_on: The small word "of" or "each" right after a number plus a unit such as cycles, patients or tablets. It also fires on "every" after "once".

modes.label: "of" after cycles
modes.description: The word "of" after a number of chemotherapy cycles, leading into the regimen name.
modes.example: fewer than 4 cycles<< of>> platinum-based chemotherapy

modes.label: "each" after a count
modes.description: The word "each" after a number of patients or tablets, giving a per-item amount.
modes.example: one tablet<< each>> morning and evening

modes.label: "every" after once
modes.description: The word "every" after "once", in a repeat interval.
modes.example: be repeated once<< every>> three hours
